51574459.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant Influenza A virus polymerase PB2 cap-binding domain (318 to 413 residues) assessed as dissociation constant by ITC method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.6. Isothermal: The binding affinities between the compounds and recombinant PB2 protein were measured by ITC (MicroCal ITC200, Malvern Panalytical). The buffer was 20 mM Tris-HCl (pH = 8.0), 150 mM NaCl and 0.1% b-ME. Measurement was performed under 25 °C. In the syringe, the concentrations of tested compounds were around 0.3 mM while the protein concentration in the cell was around 0.03 mM. The data was analyzed through MicroCal ITC-ORIGIN Analysis Software (Malvern Panalytical).
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Fig. 4. Binding affinity of selected HAAs (HAA-08/HAA-09/HAA-15/HAA-16) to PB2_cap (318–413) is measured by ITC. Raw ITC data is shown in the upper panel and the integrated data fitted to a single-binding site model is shown in the lower panel.
